mark_scheme.criterion: States: energy stored by a mass because of its position or height in a gravitational field.

hints: Recall the controlled definition of gravitational potential energy from the Cambridge syllabus.
Include the terms: energy stored, by a mass, because of its position or height, in a gravitational field.
solution: Gravitational potential energy is the energy stored by a mass because of its position or height in a gravitational field.
teacher_walkthrough: Emphasize the exact wording required by the mark scheme.
